decisive_items: biopsy of inflamed areas demonstrated acute inflammation and foci of endometriosis
at which time endometriosis was noted
no appendix despite full mobilization of the cecum and small-bowel run
response.rationale: Biopsy confirmed endometriosis in inflamed areas, and prior history plus absent appendix support endometriosis as the underlying cause; other candidates are either initial presumptions, complications, or differentials without tissue confirmation.

rejected.why: Laparoscopy found no appendix, contradicting acute appendicitis despite initial imaging suspicion.
Small-bowel obstruction is a downstream complication, not the primary diagnosis.
Neoplasm was only listed in the differential without supportive histology or imaging specificity.
Inverted appendix was a differential consideration but not confirmed; biopsy favored endometriosis.
